title: Assassin's Creed II
summary: 32-bit dgVoodoo DX11 HDR mod with PsychoV-30, reconstructed LUT grading, FP16 intermediates, and HUD brightness control.
notes: Requires dgVoodoo translating DX9 to DX11 and 32-bit ReShade with addon support.
Includes Ghost of Tsushima's PsychoV-30 and color-grading controls; no effect controls.
Normal gameplay verifies FP16 scene headroom; other aspect ratios, special rendering paths, and resource recreation need further validation.
